.rounds-drawer-head,.board-head,.court h3,
  .lineup-fields label {
    color:#d5b991!important;
  }
  small,.muted,.scorehint,.club-scoresub,.board-bottom,.prepare-next-heading p,

  .setup-card .field .hint,.format-summary p {
    color:#b5bec9!important;
  }
  .club-win,.stat strong,.verdict-points .stat strong {color:#f0d5ad!important;}
  th,.unified-table thead th {color:#d4b995!important;border-bottom-color:#647078!important;}
  td,.unified-table tbody td {border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,.075)!important;}
  .rank,.gold-text,.leaderboard-rank {color:#dfc39a!important;}
  /* The master uses deep mineral inputs with quieter borders, rather than opaque grey boxes. */
  input,select,textarea,.setup-card .p5-date-display,
  .setup-card input,.setup-card select,
  .master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input,
  .roster-group .p5-dual-pair-row input,
  .match-center .court-score-input,
  .history-inline-editor>label input,.lineup-fields select,.score-edit input,

    background:#121a21!important;
    border:1px solid #526069!important;
    color:#f5eee3!important;
    box-shadow:none!important;
  }
  input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder {color:#9fa9af!important;opacity:1;}
  /* Master setup selects/date controls use #141c23 with #505a63 edges. */
  .setup-card select,.setup-card .p5-date-display {
    background:#141c23!important;border-color:#505a63!important;
  }
  .setup-card #matchFormat:has(option:checked[value=""]) {color:#aab3ba!important;}
  .setup-card .p5-date-display>span {color:#aab3ba!important;}
  .setup-card .p5-date-shell.has-date .p5-date-display>span {color:#f5eee3!important;}
  .match-center .court-score-input,input[type=number].court-score-input,
  .score-edit input {background:#11181e!important;border-color:#4e5b65!important;color:#f8deba!important;}
  input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible,button:focus-visible {
    outline:2px solid #dcc49c!important;outline-offset:2px!important;
  }
  /* Buttons and active selector tones from production master (champagne/slate). */
  button {background:#2b343b;border-color:#4b555b;color:#ebe8e1;}
  button.primary,.form-actions button.primary,.setup-home-actions button.primary {
    background:#ccb18c!important;border:1px solid #d5bf9e!important;
    color:#171d22!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff55!important;
    font-weight:760;
  }
  button.ghost,.setup-clear-button {
    background:#2b343b!important;border:1px solid #67717a!important;color:#ebe8e1!important;
  }
  .setup-courts .choice:not(.selected) {
    background:#202a32!important;border-color:#4d5862!important;color:#e1e1df!important;
  }
  .setup-courts .choice.selected,.roster-team-tab.active,.leaderboard-filter.active,
  .round-chip.active,.round-chip.selected,.roundbuttons button.selected {
    background:linear-gradient(110deg,#4d4030,#393630)!important;
    border:1px solid #c9ad88!important;color:#f2ddbb!important;
  }
  .club-board .versus,.club-side .versus,.prepare-index {color:#d6b990!important;}
  /* Full-width admin drawer adopts the same translucent master panel family. */
  .global-dock #mainMenu,.global-dock #mainMenu[open] {
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(29,43,55,.73),rgba(16,28,39,.75))!important;
    border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.23)!important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(110%)!important;
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(110%)!important;
  }
  .global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-menu {
    background:rgba(10,20,30,.39)!important;
    border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.25)!important;
  }
  .global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-content,
  .global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-icon {background:rgba(10,20,30,.39)!important;}
  .global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-section>summary,
  .global-dock #mainMenu>summary {color:#f2ede4!important;}
  /* Stage 2 & decider card variants must not retain old standalone graphite. */
  .duel-row,.team-duel-card,.decider-card,.score-review,
  .stage2-summary,.stage3-summary,.stage2-match,.stage3-match,
  .final-verdict {color:var(--light)!important;}
  .champion,.champion-card {
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 5%,rgba(84,69,51,.76),rgba(37,42,43,.88) 65%)!important;
    border-color:#b79a72!important;
  }
  footer.foot {color:#c9ad88!important;}
}

  }

.arrival-team-title span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.arrival-team-title small{flex:none;font-size:9px;color:#cbb493}
.arrival-team-pairs{display:grid;gap:6px}.arrival-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:19px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:5px;width:100%;min-height:43px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #485862;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(36,50,62,.74);color:#f1ebe1;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.arrival-pair.is-late{background:rgba(40,39,40,.7);border-color:#805e54;color:#b9b2ac}.arrival-pair-number{font-size:10px;color:#d3b58d}.arrival-pair-names{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.3}.arrival-state{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.025em;color:#a9d0b9;white-space:nowrap}.arrival-pair.is-late .arrival-state{color:#dfafa3}
.arrival-panel-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:13px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #44515b}.arrival-status{color:#afbac1;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.arrival-reshuffle-btn{flex:none;min-height:41px;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.025em}.arrival-reshuffle-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}.arrival-locked-note{font-size:10px;color:#c6b398;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:560px){.arrival-panel-toggle{padding:12px 10px;font-size:10px;gap:6px}.arrival-panel-body{padding:11px 10px 12px}.arrival-grid{gap:7px}.arrival-team-title{font-size:10px;align-items:flex-start}.arrival-team-title small{font-size:8px}.arrival-pair{padding:6px 5px;grid-template-columns:13px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:48px;gap:3px;font-size:10px}.arrival-pair-names{grid-column:2}.arrival-state{grid-column:2;font-size:8px}.arrival-pair-number{grid-row:1 / 3}.arrival-panel-footer{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.arrival-reshuffle-btn{width:100%}}
